dataset_description: Synthetic Indian retail sales dataset for testing the Intelligent Analytics Query Engine.

fields.order_date: Calendar date on which the order was placed.
fields.month: First day of the calendar month for the order.
fields.region: Sales region: North, South, East, or West.
fields.city: City where the sale was made.
fields.customer_segment: Customer segment: Consumer, SMB, or Enterprise.
fields.salesperson: Sales representative associated with the order.
fields.quantity: Number of units sold in the order.
fields.sales_amount: Total sales value for the order in INR.

targets.grain: One row per month and region.

fields.month: First day of the target month; joins to sales_data.month.
fields.target_sales: Sales target in INR for the month and region.

business_term_mappings.achievement: actual sales divided by target sales multiplied by 100
